#.label: Adyen cloud settings
#/properties/environment.label: Environment
#/properties/environment.description: Production is live. Sandbox is Adyen's test system. Mock is the Extenda Retail simulator, so nothing reaches Adyen.
#/properties/apiKey.label: API key
#/properties/apiKey.description: API key used to authenticate all outgoing requests to Adyen, it should be treated as a password. Generate it in your Adyen customer area (API credentials), copy and paste it here.
#/properties/webhook/properties/url.desc: The unique ID at the end of your webhook address in Adyen.
#/properties/webhook/properties/username: Basic authentication username. Must match the webhook in Adyen.
#/properties/webhook/properties/password: Basic authentication password. Must match the webhook in Adyen. Treat it like a password.
Adyen store ID for these devices. Optional.
#/properties/softpos/properties/softposA: Separate API key from Adyen for Tap to Pay. Treat it like a password.
#/properties/softpos/properties/encrypti: Name of the encryption key shared with Adyen.
At least 12 characters. Treat it like a password.
Leave at 1 unless Adyen says otherwise.
This key encrypts every message sent to: This key encrypts every message sent to Adyen's Tap to Pay app and decrypts the responses from Adyen. The three values must match the ones stored in Adyen's Customer Area.
